input: Arrange a surprise retirement party for colleagues

gold.taskTitle: Arrange a Surprise Retirement Party for Colleague
gold.taskDescription: Plan and execute a surprise retirement party for a colleague, covering all logistics, coordination, and personal touches needed to make it memorable.

questions.title: Who exactly is the retirement party being held for?
questions.description: Identify the retiree by name, role, and relationship to the organizer to personalize the planning.

questions.title: When is the retiree's last working day?
questions.description: Establish the key date to set a realistic planning timeline and choose the right party date.

questions.title: How many guests are expected to attend?
questions.description: Determine the headcount to guide venue selection, catering quantities, and budget estimates.

questions.title: What is the total budget available for this party?
questions.description: Define the financial limit to make appropriate decisions on venue, food, decorations, and gifts.

questions.title: Will the party be held at work or an outside venue?
questions.description: Clarify the preferred location type to begin scouting and booking options early.

questions.title: Who else from the team is helping to organize this?
questions.description: Identify co-organizers or a planning committee to delegate tasks and keep the surprise a secret.

questions.title: Are there themes or personal interests to incorporate?
questions.description: Gather details about the retiree's hobbies, personality, or retirement plans to shape the party's theme and tone.
